The fungus features a complex, multi-branched structure resembling marine coral, with numerous upright branches dividing into finer, club-shaped tips. It is surrounded by dry brown leaves, twigs, and sparse green grass blades. The lighting is natural and diffuse, highlighting the matte texture of the fungal branches.
